{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify cleaned data
print(f"Cleaned data shape: {data.shape}")

# Compute total converted and total orders
total_converted = data['converted'].sum()
total_orders = len(data)
print(f"Total converted: {total_converted}")
print(f"Total orders: {total_orders}")

# Compute overall conversion rate
overall_conv_rate = total_converted / total_orders
print(f"Overall conversion rate: {overall_conv_rate}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_rate_by_channel = data.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel:")
print(conv_rate_by_channel)

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = data.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("Average revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Stratify conversion rate by customer_segment and channel
conversion_by_segment_channel = data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print("Conversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)

# Compute segment counts and weights
segment_counts = data.groupby('customer_segment').size()
total_segment_count = segment_counts.sum()
weights = segment_counts / total_segment_count
print("Segment counts:")
print(segment_counts)
print("Segment weights:")
print(weights)

# Compute weighted average conversion rate by channel
weighted_conv_email = (conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] * weights).sum()
weighted_conv_paid_search = (conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search'] * weights).sum()
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_conv_email}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_conv_paid_search}")

# Compute adjusted difference
adjusted_diff = weighted_conv_email - weighted_conv_paid_search
print(f"Adjusted difference in conversion rate: {adjusted_diff}")

# Final outputs for evidence
print(f"total_converted: {total_converted}")
print(f"total_orders: {total_orders}")
print(f"overall_conv_rate: {overall_conv_rate}")
print(f"weighted_conv_email: {weighted_conv_email}")
print(f"weighted_conv_paid_search: {weighted_conv_paid_search}")
print(f"adjusted_diff: {adjusted_diff}")
print(f"avg_revenue_email: {avg_revenue_by_channel['email']}")
print(f"avg_revenue_paid_search: {avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']}")"}
